changes.title: Island shapes
items: Islands grow out from home with arms, bays and peninsulas, more irregular the further out their phase (home stays near-round)
Try a phase's shape with ?phase=1 to ?phase=5

changes.title: Hats brooms
items: Hats and brooms with spells: pick them in your room's Hat and Broom boxes
The plain broom lets you rise to the treetops again sooner; Speed is now a broom of its own
Long broom: blinks go twice as far. Double blink broom: one more blink
Helmet: takes a hit for you and falls off; pick it up to wear it again
Healing ring hat: put it down and stand by it to heal

changes.title: Swoop bottom
items: Swooping ravens, owls and bats linger 4 s at the bottom of each dive (was 2, 2 and 1), so you have time to invite them

changes.title: Scenery cuts
items: The island's scenery is cut back: no sports grounds (the old playground stays), no set pieces, no scattered rocks or odd trees, no railway wagons, signals, bridges, stairs or signposts
Twice as many ruins, and a ruined Greek temple or a stand of classical ruins on most islands
Fewer moonlit ponds, and the shells and starfish on the beach are twice the size

changes.title: Baby gap
items: Babies following you walk 5 m apart, up from 1.6 m
